name.la: Epistola de sacramentis ecclesiae (Ad Waleranni quaerelas responsio)
name.en-US: On the Sacraments of the Church (Reply to Waleran’s Complaints)
name.pt-BR: Sobre os sacramentos da Igreja (resposta às queixas de Valerano)

description.la: Anselmi responsio ad Waleranni quaerelas de ritibus Ecclesiae, de signo crucis et de operimento calicis. Textus ex editione Migne (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853).
description.en-US: Anselm’s short reply to the complaints of Waleran of Naumburg about the rites of the Church: the sign of the cross and the covering of the chalice. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A breve resposta de Anselmo às queixas de Valerano de Naumburgo sobre os ritos da Igreja: o sinal da cruz e a cobertura do cálice.

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 158 (Paris 1853), the Gerberon text; TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text 10633, from the Open Greek and Latin machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with its chapter divisions and PL chapter summaries. PL page breaks, the column numbers and the apparatus of alternative chapter numbers (al.) are dropped; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
